title: Serre vanishing for a proper morphism
statement: Let $A$ be Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], let $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ be proper [def-weil-proper-morphism], let $\mathcal F$ be a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent], and let $\mathcal L$ be an ample [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module] invertible module [def-sc-invertible-module]. There exists $n_0\ge0$ such that $H^p(X,\mathcal F\otimes\mathcal L^{\otimes n})=0$ [pqf-def-cohomology] for every $p>0$ and $n\ge n_0$.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 02O1 (coherent-lemma-kill-by-twisting), specialized to an affine base; Morphisms Lemma 01VK (morphisms-lemma-ample-over-affine) identifies absolute and relative ampleness over an affine base.
